findings.title: AI search and retrieval crawlers blocked from root (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User)
findings.evidence: Observed at https://spiegel.de/robots.txt via robots_txt_parser_longest_match [2026-09-13T16:25:17Z]: robots.txt disallows root '/' for retrieval agents: OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-User. These build the indexes AI answers are assembled from, or fetch a page live when a user asks about it, so the brand cannot be cited at all. Training-only crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Applebot-Extended, Meta-ExternalAgent, Bytespider, Amazonbot) are also blocked, which is a separate and legitimate licensing choice. (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.summary: Allow AI search and user-triggered retrieval agents, even if training crawlers stay blocked.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: In robots.txt, allow OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot and PerplexityBot (search indexes) and ChatGPT-User, Claude-User and Perplexity-User (live user fetches). You can keep GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended and CCBot disallowed if you do not want your content used for model training -- the two decisions are independent.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves crawlability by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

findings.title: Missing Schema.org Organization structured data on root landing page
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.spiegel.de/ via jsonld_schema_extractor [2026-09-13T16:25:17Z]: Root homepage contains 0 Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema blocks. (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD markup to the homepage.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a JSON-LD script on the homepage declaring @type 'Organization' with name, url, logo, and sameAs links to authoritative profiles.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves structured data by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.
suggested_action.fix_snippet:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Organization",
  "name": "DER SPIEGEL",
  "url": "https://www.spiegel.de",
  "logo": "REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_LOGO_URL",
  "description": "Deutschlands führende Nachrichtenseite. Alles Wichtige aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport, Kultur, Wissenschaft, Technik und mehr.",
  "sameAs": [
    "REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_WIKIPEDIA_OR_LINKEDIN_URL"
  ]
}
</script>

findings.title: Content images carry no text alternative, hiding any fact they display

Observed at https://www.spiegel.de/ via image_alt_coverage_inspection [2026-09-13T16:25:17Z]: 20 of 25 images (80%) have no alt attribute at all (images correctly marked decorative with alt="" are excluded). Any figure, price, spec or claim rendered inside those images is unreadable to a retrieval bot. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (crawl-render-audit): Observed at https://www.spiegel.de/services/ via image_alt_coverage_inspection [2026-09-13T16:25:17Z]: 14 of 25 images (56%) have no alt attribute at all (images correctly marked decorative with alt="" are excluded). Any figure, price, spec or claim rendered inside those images is unreadable to a retrieval bot. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (crawl-render-audit): Observed at https://www.spiegel.de/thema/angriff-auf-israel-2023-videos/ via image_alt_coverage_inspection [2026-09-13T16:25:17Z]: 25 of 25 images (100%) have no alt attribute at all (images correctly marked decorative with alt="" are excluded). Any figure, price, spec or claim rendered inside those images is unreadable to a retrieval bot. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (crawl-render-audit): Observed at https://www.spiegel.de/thema/russlands-krieg-gegen-die-ukraine-videos/ via image_alt_coverage_inspection [2026-09-13T16:25:17Z]: 25 of 25 images (100%) have no alt attribute at all (images correctly marked decorative with alt="" are excluded). suggested_action.summary: Add descriptive alt text to every image that carries information.

suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves fact extractability by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

findings.title: Brand identity is not anchored to any independent authority source
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.spiegel.de via onsite_identity_anchor_inspection [2026-09-13T16:25:26Z]: Across the crawled pages, no Organization schema is present, so no sameAs URIs can be declared, and 0 of 24 distinct outbound link domains point to an independent authority (Wikipedia, Wikidata, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, GitHub, regulatory registries). No explicit independent-authority link was observed in the sampled pages; external corroboration was not searched. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Publish machine-readable identity anchors linking the brand to independent authorities.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add Organization JSON-LD with a stable @id, legalName, and a sameAs array pointing to the brand's Wikidata item, Wikipedia article, LinkedIn company page and Crunchbase profile. Create those external profiles first if they do not exist -- sameAs pointing at nothing does not corroborate anything.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves corroboration by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

findings.title: No extractable answer on-site for "Who is DER SPIEGEL for?"
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.spiegel.de/services/ via onsite_answerability_probe [2026-09-13T16:25:26Z]: Across 5 crawled page(s), no audience or intended-user statement is extractable from the relevant crawled pages. An assistant that fetched these pages could not quote an answer to "Who is DER SPIEGEL for?" from this site, so it must fall back to third-party sources or omit the brand. (Confidence: medium)

proactive_recommendations.title: Build third-party presence so DER SPIEGEL is resolvable away from its own domain
proactive_recommendations.rationale: Only 0 independent authority domain(s) are referenced from the crawled pages. Assistants weight facts that several unrelated sources agree on, and the major platforms draw on largely different source pools -- analyses of 2026 citation data find roughly 11% domain overlap between ChatGPT and Perplexity. A brand described only on its own site is a single fragile source no matter how well that site is built.

suggested_action.summary: Establish and maintain the brand on independent platforms, then link them via sameAs.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Create or claim a Wikidata item, a LinkedIn company page, and the profiles that matter in your sector (Crunchbase, GitHub, G2, industry registries). Keep the core facts identical across them, then reference them from Organization sameAs so the identity is machine-linkable.

proactive_recommendations.title: Declare a WebSite entity with SearchAction
proactive_recommendations.rationale: No WebSite schema was found. WebSite ties the domain to the brand entity and, with a potentialAction SearchAction, lets assistants point users straight into your own search instead of guessing at URLs. It is a small, stable addition that anchors everything else on the page to a named site.

suggested_action.summary: Add WebSite JSON-LD with a SearchAction pointing at your search endpoint.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add WebSite JSON-LD on the homepage with name, url, a publisher reference to your Organization @id, and potentialAction -> SearchAction with a target URL template.

proactive_recommendations.title: State AI usage terms explicitly in robots.txt
proactive_recommendations.rationale: robots.txt names which agents may crawl but says nothing about what may be done with the content once fetched. Emerging conventions -- Cloudflare's Content Signals Policy (released CC0) and RSL licensing terms -- let a publisher separate training use from search indexing and answer generation in machine-readable form, instead of leaving that distinction to be inferred from which user agents happen to be listed.

suggested_action.summary: Add machine-readable content-usage signals to robots.txt.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a Content Signals Policy block declaring your position on search, ai-input and ai-train separately, or publish RSL licensing terms. Keep it consistent with the agents you actually allow, or the two signals will contradict each other.

proactive_recommendations.title: Expose an agent-facing endpoint (NLWeb / MCP) built on existing structured data
proactive_recommendations.rationale: The site already publishes structured data, which is the input NLWeb uses to serve a conversational endpoint that AI agents can query directly rather than scraping HTML. Because it builds on schema.org markup, sitemaps and feeds you already maintain, it is incremental rather than a rebuild, and it moves the brand from being read by agents to being queryable by them.

suggested_action.summary: Evaluate an NLWeb instance exposing an /ask and /mcp endpoint over existing content.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Point an NLWeb instance at your existing schema.org data and sitemap, and expose /ask and /mcp. Start with the content an agent is most likely to be asked about -- catalogue, docs, pricing.

proactive_recommendations.title: Consider publishing llms.txt, with realistic expectations
proactive_recommendations.rationale: No /llms.txt is published. Be aware this is a low-evidence convention rather than an established standard: 2026 measurements find major AI crawlers almost never request the file, and Google has stated it has no effect on Search or AI Overviews. It costs very little to publish and may matter if uptake improves, but it should be treated as optionality -- not as a substitute for the structured data and third-party presence that demonstrably drive citation today.

suggested_action.summary: Optionally publish /llms.txt, after the higher-leverage items above.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: If you publish one, keep it to a short markdown index of your canonical product, docs, pricing and company pages, and keep it in sync with the site. Do not deprioritise schema work for it.
